identitySignals: Company 'Brigaid' on its own website (chefsbrigaid.com) lists its address in Middletown, CT, matching the agenda's 'Brigaid, LLC, Middletown, CT'
Website describes placing professional chefs in school foodservice programs, matching OUSD's Nutrition Services Department contracts
A CulinaryAgents listing shows a Brigaid Oakland, CA location doing school food work, consistent with a contract with Oakland Unified
research.notes: No phone or email published on the site (contact form only). No registry record (CT Secretary of State, SAM.gov) was checked directly, so legal name and registry IDs are left null. Third-party directories list the suite as #404, but the company's own pages show #2404; the company's own pages were used.

profile.summary: Brigaid is a company founded in 2016 that helps institutional food programs, including school districts, improve the meals they serve. It offers program assessments, staff training and placement of professional chefs. It has worked with schools, nonprofits, senior organizations and a prison system.

review.notes: Brigaid's own About and Contact pages show the Middletown, CT address matching the agenda's 'Brigaid, LLC, Middletown, CT', and describe placing chefs in institutional food programs, consistent with OUSD Nutrition Services contracts. The summary, orgType, website, address and headquarters are supported and neutral; the CulinaryAgents Oakland listing was not independently verified but is not used for any profile field.
